title: Famous New Testament verses
note: Most of these lines are quoted from the Greek New Testament. Watch how much of the grammar you now know: ἦν and ἐστιν, articles marking the subject, the aorist ἐγένετο, and prayer forms such as ἁγιασθήτω and ἐλθέτω, third-person commands: 'let it be hallowed', 'let it come'. The Lord's Prayer comes from Matthew 6:9–11.

src.t: SBL Greek New Testament, John 1 (Bible Gateway)

items.a: In the beginning was the Word.
d: In the beginning God made the Word.
The Word was the beginning of God.
and the Word was in the flesh

items.c: Ἐγώ εἰμι ἡ ὁδὸς καὶ ἡ ἀλήθεια καὶ ἡ ζωή.
items.a: I am the way and the truth and the life.
d: I know the way to truth and life.
I am the light and the truth and the life.
items.r: Egō eimi hē hodos kai hē alētheia kai hē zōē.

items.c: Ἐγώ εἰμι ἡ ἀνάστασις καὶ ἡ ζωή.
items.a: I am the resurrection and the life.
d: I am the way and the life.
I am the door and the life.
items.r: Egō eimi hē anastasis kai hē zōē.

items.c: Ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ ἄρτος τῆς ζωῆς.
items.a: I am the bread of life.
d: I am the light of life.
I give the bread of life.
items.r: Egō eimi ho artos tēs zōēs.

items.c: ὁ λόγος ὁ σὸς ἀλήθειά ἐστιν.
d: The truth is your word alone.
items.r: ho logos ho sos alētheia estin.

items.c: νυνὶ δὲ μένει πίστις, ἐλπίς, ἀγάπη
items.a: So now faith, hope and love remain.
d: Now faith, hope and love have passed away.
Faith and hope remain, but not love.
items.r: nyni de menei pistis, elpis, agapē

items.c: Πάτερ ἡμῶν ὁ ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς
items.r: Pater hēmōn ho en tois ouranois

items.c: Τὸν ἄρτον ἡμῶν τὸν ἐπιούσιον δὸς ἡμῖν σήμερον.
items.a: Give us today our daily bread.
d: We gave you our bread today.
items.r: Ton arton hēmōn ton epiousion dos hēmin sēmeron.

items.a: Blessed are the poor in spirit
d: Blessed are the pure in heart

items.c: Ἀγαπήσεις τὸν πλησίον σου ὡς σεαυτόν.
items.a: You shall love your neighbor as yourself.
d: Your neighbor will love you as himself.
You loved your neighbor as yourself.
items.r: Agapēseis ton plēsion sou hōs seauton.

items.c: Ἐγώ εἰμι τὸ Ἄλφα καὶ τὸ Ὦ.
items.a: I am the Alpha and the Omega.
d: I am the bread and the wine.
I am the light and the life.
items.r: Egō eimi to Alpha kai to Ō.

items.a: the truth will set you free
d: the truth has set us free
the law will set you free

items.a: all things came into being through him
d: all things will come to him

items.a: Jesus Christ, Son of God, Savior (ΙΧΘΥΣ, fish)
d: Jesus Christ, Lord of all, King (ΙΧΘΥΣ, fish)
Jesus, Christ of the people (ΙΧΘΥΣ, fish)

read.title: John 1:1–5
text: Ἐν ἀρχῇ ἦν ὁ λόγος, καὶ ὁ λόγος ἦν πρὸς τὸν θεόν, καὶ θεὸς ἦν ὁ λόγος. οὗτος ἦν ἐν ἀρχῇ πρὸς τὸν θεόν.
πάντα δι’ αὐτοῦ ἐγένετο, καὶ χωρὶς αὐτοῦ ἐγένετο οὐδὲ ἕν. ὃ γέγονεν ἐν αὐτῷ ζωὴ ἦν, καὶ ἡ ζωὴ ἦν τὸ φῶς τῶν ἀνθρώπων· καὶ τὸ φῶς ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ φαίνει, καὶ ἡ σκοτία αὐτὸ οὐ κατέλαβεν.

q.q: According to the passage, who was with God in the beginning?
